{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The NPC voted unanimously to endorse the Global Call on China to Release Arrested Jasic Labor Activists.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Workers at Shenzhen Jasic Technology reported labor rights violations to local authorities in May, including illegal work rotas, an illegal system of fines, and underpayment of social insurance contributions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Workers at Shenzhen Jasic Technology organized a union drive in accordance with China Trade Union Law, and co-workers signed a petition in support of union recognition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Management and the All-China Federation of Trade Unions (ACFTU) accused worker organizers of illegally unionizing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Jasic threatened and fired worker organizers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Authorities arrested protesting workers on July 27.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Amnesty International states that thirty people detained at a factory worker protest must be released.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Fourteen of the twenty-nine arrested workers and their allies remain in detention.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Workers and their allies were unjustly arrested for unionizing and organizing solidarity actions in China.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
